hook.head: Fix your Instagram bio in 30 seconds.
hook.vo: Your Instagram bio is losing you customers. Here's the fix.

tips.n: Number one. Say what you sell.
tips.vo: In the first line, say exactly what you sell. Not a quote. Not just emojis. Just: specialty coffee and fresh cakes.
tips.head: Say what you sell.

tips.vo: Second line: your city and your area. People want to know if they can actually come to you.
tips.head: Say where.

tips.n: Number three. One link that works.
tips.vo: Use one link that goes straight to your menu and your order button. Every extra tap loses people.
tips.head: One link that works.

msgs: Where can I see the menu?
Tap the link in our bio. Menu, prices and ordering are all there.

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
